build_video_transforms_pipeline: build a VideoTransforms pipeline from an OmegaConf config to compose multiple video transforms
create_video_random_crop: create a VideoRandomCrop processor with a given size to randomly crop video frames
create_video_normalize: create a VideoNormalize processor with mean and std to normalize video tensor values
create_video_resize: create a VideoResize processor with a target size to resize video frames
create_video_to_tensor: create a VideoToTensor processor to convert video data to a normalized float tensor
